From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick post-call recap and a couple of asks so we can get you an accurate pricing proposal: 

TL;DR / next steps:
- You’ll send the small profiling CSV (avg prompt/completion tokens + 30 sample payloads).
- We’ll prepare a pricing grid showing expected $/1M tokens at your volume tiers and recommended context (8k/32k/128k) tradeoffs.
- Proposed follow-up: Tue 12/8 10am PT to walk the numbers.

What I captured from our call:
- Workload: multi-turn assistant embedded in Acme’s support app; heavy context use from internal KB + past convo history.
- Current usage estimate: 25M-80M tokens / month (varies by feature).
- Profile: Avg prompt tokens ~1.2k, avg completion tokens ~600.
- Context needs: roughly 90% of requests fit comfortably within 8k context; ~10% require 32k; <1% need >64k (~128k occasionally for long-thread summarization).
- Target economics: you mentioned target unit economics in the $8–$12 per 1M tokens range for budgeting discussions.

As discussed, the two levers that materially change unit cost are (1) model selection/quantization and (2) batching & prefix caching. I’ll include notes in the pricing grid about expected per-token price swings if you go with 8k-only vs hybrid 8k+32k.

Attachments: I attached the Redwood pricing grid (redwood_pricing_grid_v2.xlsx) — it has placeholders we’ll fill after we get your CSV.

Please reply with the profiling CSV (acme_context_profiling_20261205.csv) and any additional volume bands you want modeled (e.g., 1M / 10M / 50M / 100M tokens).

Thanks — speak soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Monthly budget range for this POC / initial rollout: $15k — $45k / month. If performance and unit economics look good, we plan to expand to ~$60k / month in Q2.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Perfect — got the CSV, thanks. I ran a quick pass with our Pricing Toolkit and wanted to share preliminary numbers before the call so you have context. These are illustrative (model/quantization TBD):

Assumptions used (prelim):
- Model: open-weights LLM (production-optimized) — room to swap for higher-cost LLMs.
- Avg prompt tokens = 1,150; avg completion tokens = 620 (per CSV median).
- Effective tokens per request = 1,770 (includes overhead for metadata).

Prelim unit economics (illustrative):
- 8k-only baseline pricing: $11.50 / 1M tokens
- Hybrid 8k+32k (auto-route burst): $13.20 / 1M tokens (weighted by 90% @8k price, 10% @32k price)
- Per-1k-requests example (using 1,770 tokens/request):
  - 1k requests ≈ 1.77M tokens → 8k-only cost ≈ $20.36; hybrid cost ≈ $23.36

Impact levers:
- Batching and prefix caching can reduce billable tokens on repeated prompts by up to 20–35% depending on your reuse patterns.
- Quantization to int8 / optimized kernels could reduce runtime cost by ~10–25% vs float models (depends on latency targets).

Action items for the call:
- I’ll bring a more complete pricing worksheet with 1M / 10M / 50M / 100M modeled bands (sheet is in the attached redwood_pricing_grid_v2.xlsx).
- Jordan will join to discuss dedicated capacity vs hosted (if you prefer committed discounts + SLA).
- Please confirm whether the 128k cases must be served in real-time (rare) or can be batched/scheduled. If they can be batched, we’ll exclude them from the hybrid pricing and show a lower blended $/1M.

See you Tue — I’ll share the updated grid an hour before the call.

—
Marissa
<Attachment: redwood_pricing_grid_v2.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)>
